NewTube:

A privacy-friendly YouTube client for desktop and mobile. Watch videos without the ads, the tracking or the clutter: your subscriptions and history stay on your device.

What it does:

• Watch YouTube videos with a real player: quality selection, audio-only mode and proper fullscreen.
• Subscribe to channels without an account. Your subscriptions live on your device, not in the cloud.
• Search videos and channels, browse channel uploads and keep a local watch history.
• Runs on Android, iOS, Linux, Windows and macOS, plus a web version.

Get it:

The landing page has screenshots and one-click downloads for every platform, or grab the files.

• Android: .apk or .aab.
• iOS: .ipa via the AltStore source below.
• Linux: AppImage, Flatpak repo, .deb, .rpm, .zip.
• Windows / macOS: .zip.
• Web: httpanimations.gitlab.io/newtube/app/.
